Home 3–2 Away in the Metrica Sample (anonymised) — a win for Home. Home produced 13 shots worth 1.72 xG; Away managed 11 shots worth 1.32 xG.

Goals: Player10 (Home, 8′, xG 0.41); Player24 (Away, 35′, xG 0.27); Player9 (Home, 49′, xG 0.28); Player20 (Away, 76′, xG 0.16); Player12 (Home, 80′, xG 0.05).

The biggest chance that got away: Player10 (Home) with a 0.42-xG opportunity in the 65′ that ended on target.

On the balance of chances, Home edged the underlying numbers by 0.4 xG.
